note: The trigger test for research-and-development, the Research & Development (R&D) department: should-trigger phrasings for each mode it holds (research, ideas and build, each carried over from the skill it absorbed), for user research, and for the user's own life, and near misses a neighbouring department owns, each with the skill it routes to. Activation is proven by a skill tool call in a real run, never by reading the description; this set is the build mode's worked example. evals.py --draw copies it into evals/skills/research-and-development.json.
